## What we do

::: {.ways}

::: {.way}
### [Gatherings](community/index.qmd)

[Practitioners' Circle](community/practitioners-circle.qmd) is for
practitioners who want to lead groups. [Moving
Together](community/moving-together.qmd) is a movement retreat for anyone.

::: {.way}
### [Writing](writing/index.qmd)

Where there is research, we look at what is known and what is not. The first
posts are coming soon.
:::

::: {.way}
### [The podcast](podcast/index.qmd)

We will talk with people who work with the body. The first episodes will be
on authenticity in everyday life, and on shame and guilt.
